title: Not for tall people
text: Not for tall people. Looked nice if not durable, recipient is just under 6 ft and is unable to recline comfortably, footrest hits mid-calf and top of chair only hits shoulders-reminds me of adults visiting kindergarten and trying to sit in the seats.
